text:
The MGAP national forest cartography (version 2021), from Uruguay's Ministry of Livestock, Agriculture and Fisheries, is the source that points to a pine plantation. Over the 2021 loss area it maps 68.1 ha as planted forest, with the species listed as Pinus elliottii and Pinus taeda. A further 13.2 ha falls outside mapped forest, and 0 ha is native forest.

The other sources don't give forest type. Hansen GFC measures the loss itself (81.3 ha in 2021, 2.23% of the asset). JRC GFC2020 only confirms that forest was present in 2020 (0.98 agreement), and it includes plantations without distinguishing them.

The MGAP map gives territorial context, not cause. The evidence does not establish whether the loss was a harvest, fire, storm or clearing, nor whether it was legal or who was responsible.
